messages:
Alex: heads-up — customer hit a 413 on /v1/embeddings when sending a mixed-dim batch. payload ~3.8MB, four different vector lengths in one request.
Priya: ouch. where did the 413 originate? ingress LB or our preflight? any logs?
Alex: connector logs show "PayloadTooLarge: 413" from the ingress LB. our current preflight doesn't inspect inner array shapes since client sent a single Content-Length header. so we only saw it after the LB rejected it.
Jamie: that means wasted traffic and poor UX. we need an earlier signal for mixed dims and per-item byte checks.
Kyle: proposal: add an optional lightweight server-side preflight that reads the first N bytes and returns a shapes summary. cheap, non-breaking for clients if opt-in via header.
Priya: console/SDK side: surface a local preflight before submit in the UI or SDK so users get immediate feedback and a suggested split-by-dims with estimated cost.
Alex: server-side opt-in header idea: X-Preflight: true. response 200 with JSON shape summary OR 4xx with a "split_suggestion" plan. clients opt in during deploy.
Jamie: router implications: when mixed dims are detected, router should transparently split into dim-homogeneous sub-batches and route to appropriate shards. today router rejects mixed-dim groups.
Kyle: router change ok but quotas become tricky — splitting implies multiple downstream requests. we need a parent-request-id and atomic quota debit or an aggregated billing record.
Priya: console copy idea: inline warning: "Request includes vectors of mixed lengths — split to avoid rejection and reduce tail latency." CTA: "Auto-split" / "Edit" / "Cancel". also show estimated size per sub-batch.
Alex: telemetry wishlist: preflight.failures.v1, preflight.splits.count, split.latency.delta_ms, route.fallback.count. tag by customer_id, model_family, dims_signature. anonymize example payloads for heuristics.
Jamie: +1. capture a small sample of payload sizes (hashed) to reproduce split heuristics offline.
Kyle: rollout plan: behind feature flag. start with internal + beta orgs. if preflight-to-split errors >1% or split adds >30% latency for org, disable auto-split for that org and surface manual suggestion.
Priya: UI needs an estimate of post-split cost. can we use a tokenizer estimate service?
Alex: eng-runtime already has a tokenizer microservice. add /estimate-embed-cost that accepts shapes and returns per-sub-batch token and byte estimates. keep it lightweight.
Jamie: internal API debate: should preflight return machine-readable "split_plan" for SDKs to auto-split and retry, or only human text for the console? I lean machine-readable + suggestion text.
Priya: machine-readable split_plan + UI-friendly suggestion string. SDKs can auto-apply split_plan deterministically.
Kyle: deterministic split must respect quotas and rate limits. include billing_parent_id and expected_token_count per sub-batch in split_plan.
Alex: action items:
 - Jamie: draft preflight API + response schema (ETA: 24h)
 - Kyle: write router & quota aggregation design doc (ETA: 48h)
 - Priya: produce console wireframes and copy (ETA: 72h)
 - EngRuntime: expose /estimate-embed-cost (small PR)
 - Observability: add telemetry keys and dashboard stub
Priya: I'll open a tracker and attach console mocks. tagging @Martha-bot for deploy scheduling.
Martha-bot: noted. creating ticket INF-3284 and adding to eng-platform board. :robot_face: 
Alex: keep rollout behind flag and enable for beta orgs only. rollback criteria: >1% preflight-to-split error or severe perf regression.
Jamie: add perf guard: if splitting increases avg latency for an org by >30%, don't auto-split — show manual suggestion instead.
Kyle: I'll post the quota aggregation proposal here once drafted. includes parent-id semantics and billing event model.
Priya: thanks everyone — I'll link the ticket and upload the console mock shortly.
Alex: thanks — good short plan. I'll add example payloads and a tiny reproducer to the ticket for devs.
